dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: Hello, my rising graffiti stars. Anything else you'd like to know?

dialogues.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
dialogues.text: If there's nothing else, get ready to head out! I'll be out for a walk through the wilds myself. Gotta look for good cliffsides that haven't been painted yet. Don't you be slower than me, now!

choices.text: Tell me about graffiti as an art form...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm. It's all over Natlan in crazy colors — on houses, trees, mountains, even on people...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It seems to be a custom here, so... when did it start?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Aha, interested in hearing some graffiti history, are you? Good, good!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: The techniques we ordinary people now master are generalized forms of "Phlogiston Engravings."

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: You might have heard of the process itself, where professional inscribers use blades to carve such engravings for mighty tribal warriors.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Each tribe has an engraving unique to them, and they are immensely useful, whether for communicating with Saurian companions, or in battle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that does ring a bell... So that's what it's called.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's no ordinary body of symbols...

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Indeed! For us normal folks, these symbols are marks of courage, ability, and honor. Nothing more avant-garde than these, if you ask me!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: That's why many imitate the inscribers and spray similar patterns in various locations.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Of course, they're mighty champions, and we're pretty mundane by comparison, so our works don't serve much purpose beyond expressing our emotions.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Over time, the artistic content expanded from those patterns into all manner of different expressions, growing increasingly free-spirited, eventually evolving into its modern form.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Symbols of the strong, huh? That kinda makes sense... Who'd have thought graffiti had such a long history...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, we could pick a few large buildings in the Serenitea Pot and cover their walls in huge pictures of all the formidable people we've met during our journey!

choices.text: Haha, then let's start with that bard!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That would work! Why don't we draw a bunch of kittens nearby, too?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Haha, draw on. Draw 'em all, even!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Once your skills mature, you can showcase all the companions and objects you want, no problem!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: But before that, you need to understand the core philosophy behind graffiti, and you need practice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course! But just you wait — we're quick learners and then some!

choices.text: Our well-traveled, knowledgeable consultant would make the perfect candidate too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, yeah. Just the thought of it puts Paimon at ease! ... Wait, but would Tubby ever dare take a nap again?

choices.text: How about a Statue of Her Excellency, the God of Thunder?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Should we paint her in a more majestic pose? Maybe raise a couple more Finches?

choices.text: What say you to Mahakusaladhamma, the Blessed One of Wisdom?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should decorate the Realm Within with some extra pretty flowers and plants, then!

choices.text: Perhaps Fontaine's number-one star might be a good pick.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great idea — we'd need a super gorgeous open-air stage to go with it, and maybe some pretty lighting too...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You always have lots to say about "avant-garde." Did you have a teacher who particularly emphasized that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Paimon guesses that you've never left Natlan before, so are there schools here that specialize in teaching art?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: School? Never been anywhere like that.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: I'm speaking from experience here, combined with books I've read that adventurers brought in from beyond our lands — of course, it took me a long while to figure it out.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: If anything, I'm the one teaching others, no?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: It just so happens that I plan on leaving a training area in the Graffiti Alliance headquarters...

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: If I manage to help you uncover your talent, I might as well handle any newcomers in future too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Headquarters? Paimon thought your Alliance also existed as a sort of identity. Y'know, like Genius Invokation TCG players.

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Well, we do have the... lofty ambition of matching the Adventurers' Guild, so having a headquarters is a must, even if that means a bit of fundraising!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Our current plans have us finishing it in short order, so if you get the chance, do drop by and hang out with us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's been meaning to ask that too. Is "Dopey Dazzler" your real name?

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: As graffiti artists, our real names aren't anywhere near as important as our titles!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Mine comes from a very, very, very awesome friend...

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: She said I have an uncanny ability to discover dazzling color combos, and others say that I get all dopey when blending paints... So I combined the two, and the rest is history!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: We haven't had much opportunity to hang out since we first met, but that title has been a massive inspiration to me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A nickname inspired by an awesome friend... Guess that makes sense...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But as for the word "dopey"... Eh, guess "avant-garde" doesn't involve being too concerned about the meaning of individual words.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup. We'll continue our search for inspiration, just as you've taught us!

response.speaker: "Dopey Dazzler"
response.text: Right on! Don't forget to use both your heart and your head! Let your imagination run wild!
